diagnosis: Indolent NK-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract, involving the stomach
legend: The gastric mucosa shows expansion of the lamina propria by an atypical lymphoid infiltrate (shown here). The lymphoid cells are medium-sized and usually have indented nuclei. Brightly eosinophilic granules can often be appreciated in the pale-staining cytoplasm (Fig. <<49964>>).
